title: Generation as Compositeness: A Subconstituent Interpretation of the $B$-Lattice Flavor Hierarchy
summary: We interpret the $B$-lattice flavor framework as a compositeness hierarchy: all three fermion generations are elementary chiral fields, but third-generation Yukawa couplings are undressed ($Q=0$), while lighter generations acquire their Yukawa couplings through chains of spin-$0$ subconstituents (``hops'') whose depth is counted by the $\mathbb{Z}_9$ discrete gauge symmetry. The $\mathbb{Z}_9$ charge admits a two-index decomposition $q_9\mapsto(a,b)$ that identifies two hop species ($α$, $β$) and organizes all fundamental scales from $v_{\rm EW}$ to $M_{\rm Pl}$ on a ``ninths ladder''…
